text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Tore-san, do you still have some time? 
There's a place I'd like to visit 
together, if that's all right...
choice_data_list: I'm free. Where do you want to go?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
A projection mapping 
museum.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...The other day, while helping out the 
beautification committee, 
someone recommended a limited-time floral 
exhibit 
currently being held at the museum.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
They said the 'experience' was 
magnificent. 
...Not just the visual beauty, but the 
experience itself.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I was a little curious about what they 
meant, 
so I thought I would experience it 
firsthand.
choice_data_list: I see. Let's go check it out then!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...It's pitch black... If I remember 
correctly, 
the images are projected across the entire 
room, right?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The theme of this projection mapping is 
said to be 
'Flowers and the Four Seasons.' I wonder 
what kind of visuals—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, it's starting! 
Cherry blossoms... Wow, they're so 
beautiful...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...This park, it's that place, isn't it! 
The one famous for cherry blossom 
viewing...!
choice_data_list:
Yeah. Everything's in full bloom! What a 
sight...!

Yeah. Everything's in full bloom! So 
magnificent...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To see both cherry blossoms and tulips at 
their peak. 
Hehe, what a luxury.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The scene changed. A festival... It's 
summer, then! 
But where are the flowers...?
choice_data_list:
Ah, they're selling Chinese lantern 
plants!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see. I thought of sunflowers when 
thinking of summer... 
Hehe, it really feels like an assortment 
of summer delights.
choice_data_list:
Blossom viewings, festivals... It brings 
back so many memories.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Familiar sights and sounds evoke fond, 
nostalgic memories. Laughing out loud 
beneath the blossoms, 
running around carefree at summer 
festivals...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Memories... is it?
choice_data_list: Yeah, memories of good times, I guess.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To me... while it's certainly more vivid 
than reality, 
it felt somewhat different from the real 
flowers I've seen.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps it's because I haven't attended 
lively blossom viewings 
or festivals very often... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Is that... what they meant by 
experience...?

text_block_list.name: Foreign Tourist
text_block_list.text:
Ah, how wonderful... 
This is exactly  
what I was looking for.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Caught off guard by a voice, I 
instinctively turn around. 
A woman who appeared to be a foreign 
tourist had tears in her eyes, 
whispering exclamations of wonder again 
and again.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Moved to the point of trembling... Just 
what kind 
of experience is she having right now, I 
wonder?
choice_data_list: Why not speak to her and ask?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact had been learning how to reach 
out to others. 
Now was the time to put that knowledge to 
the test.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...You're right. 
Just as you say, this is an opportunity to 
connect...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... We're already sharing the 
same experience. 
As for how to strike up a conversation, 
think back to Win Marilyn...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Hello. 
It's so beautiful, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Foreign Tourist
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it is so beautiful... 
And so wonderful!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ! Your Japanese is so good!

text_block_list.name: Foreign Tourist
text_block_list.text:
Do you think so? I am so happy to hear 
that! 
I love Japan, and I have always dreamed of 
coming here. 
And finally, I was able to make the trip!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...! 
Does that mean you got to see the sights 
you were longing for? 
You looked deeply moved.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Tourist
text_block_list.text:
Yes. My country is warm all year round, 
without four distinct seasons. 
That is why I have always yearned to see 
Japan's seasonal scenery.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Tourist
text_block_list.text:
My dream is to experience spring, summer, 
autumn, and winter in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Foreign Tourist
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, seeing all four seasons at once is 
impossible, of course. But... 
The imagery here made my dream come true!

text_block_list.name: Foreign Tourist
text_block_list.text:
The park, the shrine—I visited them during 
my trip. 
With my own memories of those places and 
the projections I just saw—

text_block_list.name: Foreign Tourist
text_block_list.text:
Ah, in my imagination, 
I can experience spring cherry blossoms, 
summer festivals—all the seasons!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
To experience it... within your 
imagination...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That is such a... such a wonderful 
experience! 
Living in Japan, it's a perspective I 
never would have imagined...!

text_block_list.name: Foreign Tourist
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It is the greatest Japanese 
experience...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Um, what other kinds of experiences 
have you had in Japan? 
I would love to hear more...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I was able to hear such fascinating 
stories...! 
When people come from different 
backgrounds and cultures, 
they perceive things so differently even 
when looking at the same scene.
choice_data_list: That goes for you and me too, Tact.
That goes for you and me too, Tact.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It truly does. Had we not talked, I never 
would have known 
that such differences existed.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
By broadening my circle... 
my own world broadens as well, doesn't it!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I... 
I want to connect with more and more 
people!
choice_data_list:
Is there anywhere specific you want to go 
to meet people?
Aiming for 100 friends, huh!
Aiming for 100 friends, right!

You might be better at making connections 
than I am.

You might be better at making connections 
than I am.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I... 
I want to connect with more and more 
people!
choice_data_list:
Is there anywhere specific you want to go 
to meet people?
Aiming for 100 friends, huh!
Aiming for 100 friends, right!

You might be better at making connections 
than I am.

You might be better at making connections 
than I am.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
In that case... next, 
let's go to your favorite place, Tore-san.
choice_data_list: My favorite place?
My favorite place?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Today, I was strongly reminded that 
you and I have grown up in different 
environments 
and lived different lives, Tore-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That's why I want to learn more about you 
going forward...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, 100 might be too few. 
Since I'm doing it, I'd like to connect 
with people all over the world.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Would you... come with me 
to broaden our horizons, Tore-san? Out into 
the world—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
But Tore-san, wouldn't it be easy for you 
to connect with other trainers?
choice_data_list:
Well, yeah. But that's more of a 
professional thing...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's true. 
Those connections would be centered around 
work, wouldn't they?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Then, will you go out with me again? 
Let us broaden our world together.

title: Connecting, and the World in View
